title: Transport worker thread blocked while closing shard

labels.name: :Distributed/Engine
labels.description: Anything around managing Lucene and the Translog in an open shard.

body:
### Elasticsearch Version

7.16.3 (but seems similar in `master` too)

### Installed Plugins

N/A

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

N/A

### Problem Description

A `transport_worker` thread might call `IndexShard#failShard`, which can block whilst waiting for some other IO to complete.

### Steps to Reproduce

Unclear, but from the stack trace it looks like an attempt to fail a replica itself failed.
